price-board-name.purpose: Karla 16px/600 names on the local cream panel; names may wrap.

components.name: Sale plate
components.description: The painted button: every order action, map action and page message.
components.css: .plate { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.55em; background:#a3301a; color:#f7eedd; font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(.82rem,1.1vw,.95rem); letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:none; padding:1.2em 1.7em; box-shadow:0 .06em 0 #8a2a18, 0 .55em 1em -.55em rgba(0,0,0,.9); transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1), box-shadow .18s ease; } .plate:hover { background:#b8381e; transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 .06em 0 #8a2a18, 0 .95em 1.5em -.6em rgba(0,0,0,.95); } .plate:active { transform:translateY(2px); box-shadow:0 .04em 0 #8a2a18, 0 .25em .6em -.3em rgba(0,0,0,.8); } .plate--invert { background:#f7eedd; color:#8a2a18; box-shadow:0 .05em 0 rgba(15,9,6,.35), 0 .55em 1.1em -.55em rgba(0,0,0,.5); }

components.name: Fare rail
components.description: Signature delivery estimate: a trial distance in km gives an example fare, driven by pointer or keyboard. Checkout uses the pin and nearer kitchen for the exact fare.
components.html: 3 KM
components.css: .rail { position:relative; height:52px; cursor:ew-resize; touch-action:none; } .rail:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e0c9a6; outline-offset:5px; } .rail__needle { position:absolute; top:0; left:calc((var(--v) - 1) / 11 * 100%); transform:translateX(-50%); background:#d8452a; box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.55); transition:left .5s cubic-bezier(.3,1.24,.42,1); } .rail.is-dragging .rail__needle { transition:left .1s linear; } .rail__tag { background:#2c2016; color:#f7eedd; padding:.28em .42em; } .rail__ticks i:first-child, .rail__ticks i:nth-child(3n) { height:20px; opacity:.9; } .rail__fares { display:none; position:absolute; top:64px; left:0; right:0; } .rail__fares em { position:absolute; left:calc((var(--i) - 1) / 11 * 100%); transform:translateX(-50%); font-size:.7rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:#b39c7c; } .rail__fares em.is-active { color:#f7eedd; font-weight:700; } @media (min-width:940px) { .rail__fares { display:block; } }

components.name: Offer line
components.description: Two ₱99 meals share one continuous vermilion-plate strip. Above 940px each name, description and price share a row; at 940px and below the name and price sit above the description.
components.html:

Chicken poppersCrispy poppers with rice, egg and a drink. Korean barbeque · yangnyeom · lemon glaze · teriyaki · creamy cheese · mango habanero.₱99
components.css: .ds-offer-strip { background:var(--verm-plate,#a3301a); color:var(--cream,#f7eedd); padding:8px clamp(20px,3vw,36px); border-radius:0; } .ds-offer { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(160px,.65fr) minmax(0,2fr) auto; grid-template-areas:"name description price"; align-items:center; gap:24px; margin:0; padding:22px 0; } .ds-offer + .ds-offer { border-top:1px solid rgba(247,238,221,.35); } .ds-offer-name { grid-area:name; font-family:var(--display,"Big Shoulders Display","Arial Narrow",sans-serif); font-weight:800; font-size:clamp(1.65rem,2.4vw,2rem); line-height:1; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-offer-description { grid-area:description; font-family:var(--text,Karla,sans-serif); font-size:.95rem; line-height:1.5; } .ds-offer-price { grid-area:price; justify-self:end; font-family:var(--display,"Big Shoulders Display","Arial Narrow",sans-serif); font-weight:900; font-size:clamp(3.2rem,5vw,4rem); line-height:.95; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } @media (max-width:940px) { .ds-offer { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto; grid-template-areas:"name price" "description description"; gap:12px 20px; } }

components.name: Photo mount
components.description: A print taped to the wall: paper border, slight rotation, painted price tag.
components.css: .mount { position:relative; transform:rotate(-1.2deg); } .mount img { display:block; width:100%; height:auto; border:6px solid #f7eedd; box-shadow:0 22px 34px -22px #000, 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05); object-fit:cover; } .tag { position:absolute; right:-10px; bottom:12px; transform:rotate(2.2deg); background:#a3301a; color:#f7eedd; font-family:var(--display); font-weight:700; font-size:1.02rem; padding:.34em .55em; }

components.name: Price-board panel
components.description: Local cream printed-menu panel inside the dark storefront: three columns above 940px, continuous stacked categories at 940px and below. Flat solid rules, square edges and no added motion.
components.html:
Shawarma

Fries · combos

Sweet · cold
components.css: .ds-board-panel { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); background:var(--cream,#f7eedd); color:var(--ink,#0f0906); padding:clamp(22px,3vw,36px) 0; border-top:6px solid var(--tan,#e0c9a6); border-radius:0; } .ds-board-col { min-width:0; padding-inline:clamp(20px,2.2vw,30px); } .ds-board-col + .ds-board-col { border-left:1px solid rgba(74,55,40,.25); } .ds-board-category { margin:0 0 4px; padding-bottom:18px; border-bottom:2px solid var(--verm-plate,#a3301a); font-family:var(--display,"Big Shoulders Display","Arial Narrow",sans-serif); font-size:clamp(1.8rem,2.7vw,2.5rem); font-weight:800; line-height:1; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--verm-plate,#a3301a); } @media (max-width:940px) { .ds-board-panel { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr); padding-block:0; } .ds-board-col { padding:24px; } .ds-board-col + .ds-board-col { border-left:0; border-top:1px solid rgba(74,55,40,.25); } } @media (max-width:700px) { .ds-board-col { padding:24px 20px; } }

components.name: Price row
components.description: Cream-panel menu row: Karla name, unpainted flexible spacer and large Big Shoulders tabular price. Promotional prices use vermilion-plate.
components.css: .ds-price-row { display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:10px; padding:13px 0; background:var(--cream,#f7eedd); color:var(--enamel,#241a12); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(74,55,40,.18); } .ds-price-row-name { font-family:var(--text,Karla,sans-serif); font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1.35; } .ds-price-row-space { flex:1 0 8px; } .ds-price-row-price { flex-shrink:0; font-family:var(--display,"Big Shoulders Display","Arial Narrow",sans-serif); font-size:2rem; font-weight:800; line-height:1; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-price-row--promo .ds-price-row-price { color:var(--verm-plate,#a3301a); } .ds-price-row:last-child { border-bottom:0; padding-bottom:0; }

components.css: .ds-menu-action { background:#a3301a; color:#f7eedd; border:0; border-radius:0; min-width:48px; min-height:52px; font-family:Karla,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.4; } .ds-menu-action:hover { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 100px rgba(224,201,166,.08); } .ds-menu-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e0c9a6; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-menu-action:active { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 100px rgba(224,201,166,.22); } .ds-menu-action:disabled { background:#4a3728; color:#b39c7c; box-shadow:none; }

narrative.overview:
The storefront is painted like the front of a jeepney. Dark enamel ground, flat painted rules, fares lettered where a passenger reads them. It is one page at / that hands you to a Flutter kiosk at /kiosk/ — the ordering flow is never re-drawn here. Bright vermilion is a state, not a surface; type-bearing surfaces are the deeper painted red so cream clears 6.5:1. Big Shoulders does the shouting, Karla does the talking. Depth is a short dark edge plus one soft cast: no hard offset slabs, no chrome gradients, no glow.

The existing storefront specification remains authoritative for `/`. The scoped additions below
record the approved menu and item chooser at `/kiosk/#/menu`, implemented with local `MenuTheme`.
They preserve the established world and do not extend to cart, checkout, staff screens or staff dialogs.
This documents the implemented category navigation, product grid and details sheet. The surface brief's
FORM and Quality bar establish refinement provenance; no seed run or new concept tournament is claimed.
Existing rendered evidence and completed review are indexed in `docs/evidence/menu-continuity.md`
and `docs/evidence/menu-*.png`; this documentation pass does not repeat their visual verification.

Within the existing dark enamel storefront, the price board uses one continuous cream printed-menu panel and a continuous vermilion-plate offer strip. This local exception supersedes earlier dark-list, dotted-leader and Karla-price descriptions for this section only; it does not change the Flutter menu. Finish review verdict: ship, with no material findings in the scoped redesign. Evidence: docs/evidence/price-board-desktop.png, docs/evidence/price-board-mobile.png and docs/evidence/price-board-offers-mobile.png. This documentation pass checks supplied captures against HTML/CSS without repeating browser verification or running tests. No new rasters ship in site/; existing assets are unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: Enamel ground with chrome rules; no glass, no blur, no glow
One bright vermilion for live state only; painted plates carry the type
Square corners, hard offset lips, painted depth
The fare rail is a working instrument (pointer + keyboard + ARIA), not a graphic
Real photos from the business, rotated like prints on a wall
Nothing invented: no hours, no phone number, no ratings

rules.name: The One Vermilion Rule
rules.body: Bright vermilion #d8452a is a live state. Any rectangle carrying type is #a3301a, #8a2a18 or cream.

rules.name: The Enamel Ground Rule
rules.body: One vertical gradient from #2b1e14 to #20160d. Depth comes from panels and plates, never from coloured glows or radial halos.

rules.name: The Signage-and-Speech Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders never sets a paragraph; Karla never sets a price.

rules.name: The Wide-Label Rule
rules.body: Functional labels are uppercase Karla at 0.16em tracking or wider, minimum 0.72rem.

rules.name: The Painted Cast Rule
rules.body: Depth is a short dark line under the edge plus one soft black cast. No hard zero-blur slabs, no coloured glow, no gradient chrome.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: Every section holds the same 1120px content column and the same left edge. The local cream price-board panel has internal column and row insets; its outer edge and offer strip stay aligned to that column.

dos: Do use cream for the local price-board menu panel, enamel for its names/prices and vermilion-plate for category headings, promotional prices and the continuous cream-lettered offer strip.
Do set functional labels at 11.5px or larger, uppercase Karla, wide tracking.
Do give raised surfaces a short dark edge plus one soft black cast, lifting 2px on hover.
Do keep the fare rail's ticks, labels and fare table outside the slider element, with tall ticks only on labelled stops.
Do rotate photo mounts 1–2° and pin a painted tag on them.
Do end with one full-bleed vermilion band and one cream plate.
Do keep the hours hole visible as a marked ‘to follow’ slot.
donts: Don't add coloured glows, zero-offset halos, radial background washes, or hard zero-blur offset slabs.
Don't use coloured left-border tabs, equal-card rows for offers, glyph icons, or a second accent hue.
Don't round corners, use backdrop-filter, or fake chrome with gradients.
Don't invent business facts — hours, phone numbers, ratings, testimonials.
Don't duplicate the ordering flow; every order action links to /kiosk/.
